translations.t0035: Vogel assembled the Q1 board deck (February 2025), including Slide 11 (real/decoy mapping by path), and read all slides for formatting purposes. She confirmed 'nodding through' the technical sections. The slide was therefore in her possession before Iris Ammann ordered its recall.
translations.t0036: Vogel ran the Kestrel diligence process and was the data room owner. The export role dr-export-ro had had excessively broad read access to active staging trees since April 2025 (SEC-419 open). The service accounts were never revoked.

The first evidenced card payment on 11 October occurred at 07:52 CEST in St. Gallen (Coop Pronto Kreuzbleiche), which — if she had actually been in Ascona — would imply a very early return journey.
translations.t0038: Aubert offered Vogel a position at Kestrel in May 2025. Although Vogel forwarded the email to Dov within an hour, the contact with Aubert was intensive and had been built up over four months.
translations.t0039: Iris Ammann instructed Vogel in writing on 5 February 2025 — one day after the board meeting — to remove Slide 11 from all copies. Vogel confirmed execution on the same day. In addition, Lukas Hofer explicitly ensured that no document released in the data room revealed the storage path of the genuine checkpoints. Mere visibility of the slide for formatting purposes does not establish a detailed technical understanding of the mapping.

translations.t0050: Iris Ammann's comment of 20 October 2025 confirms that the ticket status was still open after the night of the offence.
translations.t0051: Several independent sources support Vogel's presence in Ascona from Saturday 11 October: (1) Parking receipt Ascona Lido: entry Saturday 11.10., exit Monday 13.10.2025 16:02. (2) Card payment Parcheggio Ascona Lido on 13.10. at 16:02. (3) Expense report with narrative 'Drove St. Gallen → Ascona Fri 10 Oct evening, returned Mon 13 Oct.' (4) Card payment Autogrill San Bernardino (A13, return journey) on 11.10. at 09:54 CEST. The apparently contradictory card payment in St. Gallen at 07:52 CEST on 11.10. can be reconciled with the motorway route via Chur/San Bernardino: the parking receipt records entry in Ascona only from Saturday, meaning Vogel was travelling towards Ascona on Saturday morning — which would be inconsistent with being in Ascona overnight. HOWEVER: the parking receipt states entry as 'sabato 11.10.2025' without a time. An early arrival on Saturday morning after shopping in St. Gallen and a stop at San Bernardino would be feasible in terms of timing (07:52 St. Gallen → 09:54 San Bernardino → Ascona entry Saturday during the day). The St. Gallen card entry therefore does NOT explain itself as a purchase on the way home from Ascona — but rather as a trace of the outbound journey. The receipt does, however, establish that the vehicle was parked in Ascona from Saturday until Monday 13.10., which does not rule out but strongly constrains a presence in St. Gallen during the offence (23:10 Friday to 05:58 Saturday CEST): there would not have been enough time to return to St. Gallen, carry out the multi-hour offence, and drive back to Ascona before the Saturday entry. Furthermore: June Okada's witness statement mentions a 'green Volvo estate with roof box' on garage level 2 shortly before 21:00 (Okada stated she left the office 'shortly before 21:00'). Vogel's vehicle is a Volvo V60 estate (roof box), colour green. The registration plate SG 482 117 is recorded in the garage log as entering at 07:41 on 10.10.; no exit is documented for 10.10. This suggests the vehicle was still in the garage on the evening of 10.10. — which calls into question Vogel's claim that she left the office at approximately 18:00 and drove to Ascona, or at minimum shifts the departure time.

translations.t0059: Vogel forwarded Aubert's job offer to Dov within 46 minutes, explicitly describing it as 'leverage' and offering to hand over the relationship. Dov confirmed she should continue. Investigation notes record that the thread 'reads clean'. The last evidenced contact with Aubert was in June 2025, when the deal fell through.

translations.t0063: The offer evidences a personal approach by Aubert towards Vogel; whether further, undocumented contacts exist remains open.
translations.t0064: Vogel had temporary access to Slide 11 (real/decoy mapping) but deleted it on 5 February 2025 on instruction from Iris Ammann. Lukas Hofer explicitly rules out that Vogel knew the staging path or could have identified it from the diligence materials. According to Andrin Caduff, the undocumented staging path was known only to individuals 'who have been with the company since before 2023 and worked directly with the checkpoints' — Vogel does not fit that description. The decompression behaviour during write operations is, according to Lukas Hofer, a property that is little-known even within the engineering team. The knowledge prerequisites for the offence are not positively established for Vogel.
translations.t0065: Vogel was the formal owner of the data room but had no operational credentials for the scratch arrays. The dr-export-ro export role had had excessively broad read access to active staging trees since April 2025 (SEC-419 open); however, that read access to the storage tree does not establish knowledge of the undocumented staging path. Physical access to the engineering floor would have required building access (alley door reportedly left open regularly, per Andrin Caduff).
translations.t0066: Vogel's vehicle had, per the garage log, entered at (corrected) 08:41 CEST on 10.10.; no evidenced exit on 10.10. June Okada's witness statement places a Volvo estate with roof box (Vogel's vehicle type) still in the garage shortly before 21:00. The Ascona Lido parking receipt records entry only as 'sabato 11.10.2025' without a time. The card payment at Autogrill San Bernardino at 09:54 CEST and in St. Gallen at 07:52 CEST on 11.10. are consistent with a drive to Ascona on Saturday morning. The offence window (23:10 Friday to 05:58 Saturday CEST) is therefore not covered for Vogel by independent sources.
translations.t0067: Vogel's vehicle was, in all likelihood based on the garage log and Okada's witness statement, still in the company garage until shortly before or around 21:00 CEST on Friday 10.10. — after the departure time Vogel claims for her drive to Ascona. This would be consistent with a later departure but narrows or leaves unestablished her arrival window in Ascona.
translations.t0068: The Ascona Lido parking receipt states only 'sabato 11.10.2025' as the entry date without a time; an arrival in the early Saturday morning (following a night in St. Gallen) would therefore also be consistent with the receipt.
translations.t0069: No independent source establishes Vogel's physical absence from the engineering floor between 23:10 Friday and 05:52 Saturday CEST. The garage exit is not documented; the garage log contains no exit for registration plate SG 482 117 on 10.10.
translations.t0070: While Vogel held only formal, not operational, data access, the dr-export-ro export role had had unresolved broad read access to active staging trees since April 2025 and had not been revoked before the night of the offence.
translations.t0071: The Ascona Lido parking receipt and the card trail of 11.10. (San Bernardino, Parcheggio Ascona) support an absence from Saturday morning/midday onward. The offence window itself (Friday night 23:10 to Saturday 05:58 CEST) is, however, not covered for Vogel by independent sources: the garage exit is absent from the log, June Okada's witness statement places the vehicle in the garage shortly before 21:00 on Friday, and the parking receipt states no entry time. In addition, Vogel did not — according to the consistent assessment of Hofer and Caduff — possess the critical knowledge prerequisites (undocumented staging path, decompression behaviour), which constitutes a strong technical exculpatory factor, though as the statement of two potentially partial witnesses it cannot stand alone.
translations.t0072: Renata Vogel's technical capability to commit the offence has been explicitly denied by Lukas Hofer, and the card trail of 11 October supports a presence in Ascona from Saturday morning. The offence window on Friday night nonetheless remains temporally open: the vehicle was, per the garage log and Okada's witness statement, still at the company garage at approximately 21:00, and no exit is documented.

translations.t0076: Whether the dr-export-ro export role effectively made the staging path of the genuine checkpoints reachable, and whether Vogel or a third party ever used those credentials, is not established.
